from flask import Flask, request from bleach.sanitizer import Cleaner app = Flask(__name__) cleaner = Cleaner() @app.route('/apply', methods=['POST']) def apply(): name = cleaner.clean(request.form['name']) email = cleaner.clean(request.form['email']) job = request.form['job'] job = cleaner.clean(job) bio = request.form['bio'] bio = cleaner.clean(bio) return '''

Application Received!

Name: %s

Email: %s

Desired Job: %s

Bio: %s

''' % (name, email, job, bio)
